subject: Multiple repeats of same transects in distance (sample fraction)

messages.author: d0a14785a8f4efe8
messages.subject: Multiple repeats of same transects in distance (sample fraction)
parts:
Hi 
So this is not an advanced question. I have 3 different transects that i have walked 12 times each in 2016, which means my sample fraction is 12. But how do I chance this in distance? I suppose it should be a column in the .txt file i load in distance? I also have data from 2004 where the sample fraction is transect dependent (A 17, B 19, C12) again how do i enter this? 

Thank you for all responses, from a masterstudent stressed about her deadline! 

//  Laerke

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Multiple repeats of same transects in distance (sample fraction)
parts:
Lærke

The simplest solution to your query is to change the effort (length) of the transects you walked to be equal to 12 times the actual length.  This is necessarily the approach you need to use for your 2004 data where the number of visits is transect-dependent.
